title: YourPub - Bar & Grill Figma Template
description: YourPub is a warm, inviting bar and grill website template designed for neighborhood pubs, sports bars, and gastropubs. The design strikes a balance between the cozy warmth of a local pub and the professional polish needed for a modern business website. The hero section features a mouth-watering food and drink photography background with a semi-transparent overlay containing the pub name, tagline, and dual CTAs for 'View Menu' and 'Make a Reservation.' The menu section uses a clean two-column layout with food categories on one side and drink/draft listings on the other, each item showing name, description, and price. Daily specials are highlighted in a dedicated banner section. The events section promotes weekly happenings — trivia nights, live music, happy hour, sports viewing parties — using cards with day/time labels. A gallery section showcases the pub interior, signature dishes, and drink presentations. The about section shares the pub's story with owner profiles. Contact includes address, phone, hours of operation, and an embedded Google Maps placeholder. The footer has social media links, newsletter signup, and a back-to-top button. The color palette uses warm browns, deep greens, and cream tones — classic pub colors. Typography combines a bold slab-serif for headings with clean sans-serif for body text, giving it a traditional yet modern feel.
primary_use_case: Perfect for neighborhood pubs, gastropubs, sports bars, and grill restaurants that want a warm, inviting website with integrated menus and event listings.
style_vibe: Warm neighborhood pub aesthetic with browns, greens, and cream — traditional yet modern with a focus on food and community atmosphere.
